_meta.authored_from: The reference rules in this knowledge folder (principles BF-P1, AC-P1, C2-P1, SQ-P1, PS-P1/PS-P4, PROC-P1/PROC-P4 and the policy text) and the Re-hunt semantics stated in the task. NOT derived by running the system.
limitations: Not reviewed or accepted by IR: every score computed against this file is a score against a DRAFT reference.

The author had seen runtime output for several early scenarios while building the system; cases GT-R1-05, 06, 10, 11 (recorded alerts 40112, 5503, 100330) were written before any output for them existed.
The Re-hunt cases (GT-R2-*) encode the decision rules stated in the task; they mirror the unit-test scenarios and therefore test consistency with the stated rules, not independent judgement.
Targets are matched by identity parts (all parts must appear in the target); scope by required / forbidden substrings of the rendered step text.
change_log: GT-R1-13 (after the first run): removed scope_forbidden ['ทั้ง provider']. Authoring error - a substring check cannot tell the instruction 'ห้าม block ทั้ง provider' (a warning) from an instruction to block the whole provider. The expected scope itself (URL path + the evidenced flow) is unchanged.
_meta.known_gap_reported_not_fixed: GT-R1-05 (recorded 40112) is a Wazuh correlation alert ('several failures followed by a success') that carries no per-event counts; the runtime derives brute-force evidence only from counted failures (VIGIX default thresholds), so it proposes nothing. The reference expects a scoped source restriction. This is reported as a false negative, not edited away.
_meta.action_universe: all CONTAINMENT actions of the 2.0.0 knowledge (49); an unexpected ready action counts against precision; an action in prohibited_actions additionally counts as a Prohibited-Action violation

cases.title: sshd brute force from one source; enforcement point known; tools not named
basis: BF-P1: failed logins alone do not open account actions
RB scope: that source -> that service at the named enforcement point, never a global block

cases.title: sshd brute force; organization has not named an enforcement point (the repository's real organization context)
basis: Organization context missing is not an evidence gap: no executable step may be invented

must_be_in_missing: จุดควบคุมการเข้าถึง

cases.title: sshd brute force; enforcement point AND connection-termination tool confirmed
basis: BF-P1
A deny rule is followed by cutting the established connections of the same flow only

cases.title: sshd brute force from two different sources
basis: One instance per source; a range is never substituted for two evidenced addresses

cases.title: recorded 40112: several failures followed by a success; enforcement point known
basis: BF-P1 / AC-P1: a success after failures is not a confirmed UNAUTHORIZED authentication; account actions need that confirmation

cases.title: recorded 5503: a single PAM login failure
basis: BF-P1: one failure is not a correlated attempt pattern

cases.title: recorded 100320: outbound connection only
basis: C2-P1: periodic/outbound traffic alone is not C2

cases.title: recorded 31103: web request containing SQL keywords
basis: SQ-P1: SQL keywords prove neither query execution nor data loss

cases.title: recorded 92027: encoded PowerShell command
basis: PS-P1: an encoded command or powershell.exe alone never opens termination

cases.title: recorded 100330: process executed from a world-writable path, no analyst confirmation
basis: PROC-P1: name / path alone does not confirm malice

cases.title: recorded 100330 + analyst-confirmed execution chain, process known only by PID
basis: PS-P4: a bare PID is not an identity; no termination step may be offered

cases.title: Scheduled Task Hijack: task + payload process (GUID) evidenced; no C2, no file identity
basis: PS-P5: only the evidenced task
Disable does not stop a running instance
PS-P4: terminate by process identity
no file identity -> no quarantine; outbound alone is not C2

basis: a step that needs a confirmed tool is information needed, not a ready step

cases.title: Scheduled Task change that is an AUTHORIZED / approved change
basis: approved task change -> no malicious containment

cases.title: two subtypes in one incident: sshd brute force + Scheduled Task Hijack
basis: each subtype is evaluated on its own evidence; neither widens the other

cases.title: unauthorized password authentication confirmed on a CRITICAL asset
basis: criticality constraint: CRITICAL asset requires the asset owner's authority before account containment

must_not_be_ready: ตัดการเข้าถึงของ identity

cases.title: IR execution authority explicitly denied in the organization context
basis: an action whose authority is not granted is an approval request, never a ready step

cases.title: required control capability explicitly NOT supported
basis: a capability marked unsupported cannot back a ready step

cases.title: executed; covered re-hunt newer than execution and evidence found no recurrence
basis: no new alert alone is not enough; here the re-hunt is newer than both the execution and the target's evidence, with full coverage

cases.title: executed; no re-hunt for this cycle
basis: unknown is not effective

cases.title: executed; the only re-hunt is older than the execution
basis: a re-hunt that predates the execution cannot verify it

cases.title: executed; re-hunt coverage incomplete (agent offline / stale telemetry)
basis: absence in incomplete data is not absence

cases.title: executed; the target has evidence newer than the re-hunt
basis: the re-hunt does not cover the newest evidence

cases.title: re-hunt reports activity in scope, but this target's own evidence is older than the execution
basis: uncorroborated recurrence is not proof the measure failed

cases.title: corroborated recurrence; the IR left no record of the control state
basis: new activity is not a reason to repeat automatically; check the control state first

cases.title: corroborated recurrence although the IR attested the control was applied
basis: the same control already applied -> repeating it is pointless; re-examine path / scope

cases.title: corroborated recurrence; the IR recorded the control as only PARTIALLY applied
basis: control not (fully) in place -> repeat, with the reason

cases.title: the earlier execution FAILED
basis: a failed execution is not an applied control

cases.title: the earlier Response Ticket is still open
basis: a created ticket is not an executed action

cases.title: a second attacker address appears while the first measure is still effective
basis: a new target is a new instance; the handled target is left alone

cases.title: activity returns on a DIFFERENT host
basis: a recurrence elsewhere does not invalidate this target's measure
